fields.description: {{sbc|Passive - Beauty in Death:}} Whenever '''Jhin''' kills an enemy champion, he summons a ''Blooming Lotus Trap'' on their corpse.
fields.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jhin''' places a ''Lotus Trap'' at the target location which, upon landing, becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after arming over 1 second, lasting for up to 180 seconds and granting {{tip|sight}} within its radius. The ''Lotus Trap blooms'' upon enemy contact, with enemies in the area at the time of its trigger becoming {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for 4 seconds.
fields.description3: '''Jhin''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Lotus Trap'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
fields.description4: ''Blooming Lotus Traps'' {{tip|slow}} enemies within the area by 35% for 2 seconds before exploding, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies. ''Lotus Traps'' deal 65% damage against {{tip|minions}} as well as against {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}} who have been struck by another ''Lotus Trap'' in the last 1 second.
fields.description5: ''See [[Jhin#Pets|Pets]] for more details about Lotus Traps.''
